maya.activity: Wake up, stretch, and read the news in bed before getting dressed.
maya.intention: Ease into the morning and check for transportation news before commuting.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, then pack lunch and fill a water bottle.
maya.intention: Eat something simple and leave with lunch ready for the office.

maya.activity: Get ready to leave, collect work items, and put them in the canvas backpack.
maya.intention: Leave the house without having to conduct a small archaeological dig for my badge.
Arrive with enough time to settle before the committee meeting.

maya.activity: Work at the city transportation department, including the Monday transportation-committee meeting and follow-up work.
maya.intention: Listen carefully to unresolved complaints, document decisions, and keep the day's work moving.

maya.activity: Commute home and change out of work clothes.
maya.intention: Shift out of work mode before the evening walk.

maya.activity: Make and drink tea, put work items away, and decompress briefly.
maya.intention: Have a small pause before going back outside.
Clear my head after the meeting and get some movement before dinner.

maya.activity: Help Daniel prepare dinner and eat together at the dining table.
maya.intention: Contribute to dinner while Daniel uses up ingredients that need attention first.

maya.activity: Clear the dinner things, wipe down the kitchen, and spend quiet time with Daniel while he works at the piano or listens through headphones.
maya.intention: Reset the shared spaces without turning the evening into a full household project.

maya.activity: Read fiction and prepare clothes for tomorrow before getting into bed.
maya.intention: End the day quietly and make the morning predictable.

daniel.activity: Wake up, brush my teeth, wash, and shower while listening to a podcast from my phone.
daniel.intention: Start the day clean and alert.

daniel.activity: Grind coffee beans by hand, boil water, and make coffee while finishing the podcast.
Make and eat breakfast at the kitchen counter while talking with Maya before work.
daniel.intention: Have breakfast and connect before the workday.

daniel.activity: Edit dialogue, attend remote production calls, and monitor audio from the work setup.
Make a quick lunch and eat it standing at the kitchen counter.
daniel.intention: Refuel without interrupting the workday for too long.

daniel.activity: Continue editing and monitoring audio, joining a remote studio session if needed.
daniel.intention: Finish the afternoon audio-work block and deliver steady progress.

daniel.activity: Step away from the workstation, drink water, and carry my phone to the bar cart before cooking.
daniel.intention: Transition out of work and get ready to cook.

daniel.activity: Cook an improvised dinner using ingredients that need to be used first, tasting as I go.
daniel.intention: Make dinner before Maya returns from her walk.

daniel.activity: Finish dinner, eat at the dining table, and put the most visible cooking items away afterward.
daniel.intention: Have dinner and leave the kitchen usable.

daniel.activity: Wash up and settle the kitchen, leaving tasting spoons on the sink side while I finish clearing.
daniel.intention: Reset the cooking area before relaxing.

daniel.activity: Play digital piano arrangements and listen critically through headphones.
daniel.intention: Unwind while keeping my musical ear active.

daniel.activity: Wind down, drink water, and get ready for bed.
daniel.intention: End the day quietly and prepare for sleep.

daniel.activity: Get into bed and fall asleep.
